name: Non-tech operations role
source: Written for the eval: a non-technical operations posting from a regional distributor. Fictional company.

job.title: Operations Coordinator
job.description:
North Star Food Distribution supplies 400 restaurants, schools and grocers across Minnesota and western Wisconsin. We're looking for an Operations Coordinator to keep our warehouse, drivers and customers in sync.

Responsibilities
• Coordinate daily delivery schedules with the warehouse and 25 drivers
• Track inventory levels and place restock orders with vendors
• Handle customer calls and emails about orders, substitutions and delivery windows
• Resolve order issues and credits quickly and politely
• Keep records accurate in our ordering system and Excel
• Train new warehouse staff on receiving and food safety procedures
• Report weekly on on-time delivery, order accuracy and inventory shrink

Requirements
• 2+ years in operations, logistics, restaurant or retail management
• Strong organization and the ability to juggle many moving parts
• Comfortable with Excel or Google Sheets
• Calm, clear communication with customers, drivers and vendors
• ServSafe certification preferred (we'll pay for it if you don't have it)

Schedule and pay
Monday to Friday, 6:00am - 2:30pm. $24 - $28 per hour, health insurance, PTO, and a yearly bonus.
